User.title: User
User.description: Global user account record in Firestore representing Super Admins, Gym Admins, Trainers, and Members with role, account creation date, lock/force-unlock state, and membership expiration.

name.description: Full display name of the user

createdAt.description: ISO date string when the account was created

expiryDate.description: ISO date string when membership or lease expires

accountLocked.description: Whether the account is currently locked

forceUnlocked.description: Whether Super Admin has force-unlocked this account

forceUnlockedAt.description: ISO timestamp when Super Admin force-unlocked the account

gymName.description: Associated gym franchise or branch name

subscriptionCycle.description: Monthly, Quarterly, Half-Yearly, Yearly, or Lifetime

Member.title: Member
Member.description: A gym member profile with billing, membership expiry, lock/unlock governance, health tracking, biometric authentication, and gamified progress.

id.description: Unique identifier for the gym member

gymId.description: Parent gym tenant identifier binding this member to a Gym Owner

gymOwnerEmail.description: Email address of the parent gym owner

createdAt.description: ISO date string when account was created

joinDate.description: ISO date string when membership started

expiryDate.description: ISO date string when current membership expires

status.description: Current status of the member (Active, Expired, Pending, Inactive)

accountLocked.description: Whether the member account is locked or unlocked by admin

forceUnlocked.description: Whether the member account is force-unlocked by Super Admin

paymentConfirmed.description: Whether the latest membership payment has been confirmed via Firestore

faceGeometrySignature.description: Compact 8-point lighting-normalized geometric ratio signature for hybrid camera attendance

faceGeometryEnrolledAt.description: ISO timestamp when face geometry signature was enrolled

lastPaymentReference.description: UTR or transaction reference of the confirmed payment

lastPaymentDate.description: ISO timestamp of last confirmed payment

SystemPolicy.title: SystemPolicy
SystemPolicy.description: Global Super Admin governance policy for membership expiration, grace periods, and force-unlock overrides.

gracePeriodDays.description: Number of grace days granted globally after expiryDate

forceUnlockAllAccounts.description: Whether all accounts are globally force-unlocked by Super Admin

autoLockOnExpiry.description: Whether accounts automatically lock when membership expires

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of last policy update

updatedBy.description: Email of the Super Admin who updated the policy

Package.title: Package
Package.description: A membership plan or subscription tier with details and price.

category.description: Target tier like Elite or Basic

Invoice.title: Invoice
Invoice.description: Membership payment and billing confirmation record stored in Firestore.

status.description: Payment confirmation status (Paid, Pending, Overdue, Verification Pending, Rejected)

Attendance.title: Attendance
Attendance.description: Biometric, NFC, or Passkey attendance and gate entry logs for gym members.

memberId.description: ID of the member checking in

method.description: Verification method (e.g. RPPG, Passkey, QR, Admin)

WorkoutLog.title: WorkoutLog
WorkoutLog.description: Logged workout session with custom routine, exercises, sets, reps, and weights

memberId.description: ID of the member who performed the workout

routineName.description: Name of the custom workout routine

totalVolumeKg.description: Total volume lifted (sets x reps x weight in kg)

exercises.description: Logged exercises with individual sets, reps, and weights

GymClass.title: GymClass
GymClass.description: Scheduled gym class with trainer, schedule time, seat capacity, and bookings

type.description: Class category (HIIT, Yoga, Strength, Zumba, CrossFit, Spinning, MMA)

Admin.title: Admin
Admin.description: Cryptographically verified administrator record for elevated gym franchise control.

Payment.title: Payment
Payment.description: Payment transaction and ledger record synchronized via Supabase and Cloud Firestore.

Tenant.title: Tenant
Tenant.description: Multi-tenant gym franchise configuration record including Gym Owner identity, contact, UPI ID, Google Location, Gym Logo, and Owner Signature.

owner_name.description: Full name of the Gym Owner

location.description: Physical street address of the gym

google_location_url.description: Google Maps location URL for receipts and Member Portal navigation

upi_id.description: Gym UPI ID for fee collection and receipt payment QR

logo_url.description: Uploaded Gym Logo image URL or compressed data URI

signature_url.description: Uploaded Gym Owner Signature image URL or compressed data URI

social_links.description: Official gym social media links (WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube) reflected on the public profile

account_locked.description: Whether the gym tenant and its member portal are locked

HealthData.title: HealthData
HealthData.description: Encrypted biometric and wearable health telemetry record.

Profile.description: Canonical member, trainer, receptionist, and owner profile with biometric turnstile access flag and AI coaching preferences.
